A LITTLE GUIDE

Make room for
something bigger.

01

Choose one of three

Three jelly blobs wait in a row. The middle separates the left and right blobs. Tap any one to select it. Lift a blob upward, then move it left or right to rearrange the row. Neighbors slide aside to make room; release in the preparation row to place it. Lifting the middle blob to the right pushes the right blob into the middle. Release far away to return to the original place. Drag a blob into a matching one to merge on contact. Contacts are checked throughout dragging and the return journey, including the two sides. Matching neighbors combine automatically until the middle differs from both sides. Equal left and right blobs stay separate until you bring them together. Matching new arrivals can combine as they enter. Values can grow to 4096. The ‹ and › buttons beside Shoot select the blob to the left or right. Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 select a blob.

02

Choose your force

Pull any ready blob downward, straight or diagonally toward the bottle, to build force; the aiming arrow appears as soon as it starts charging. Release to shoot it from its own place in the row; it does not jump to the middle first. Side blobs can aim widely toward the far side but only gently toward their nearer rim, so every shot lands in the bottle. Pull farther for more force; pull back to the starting height or cancel the gesture to stop. A lifting gesture stays in preparation mode even when you lower it again. You can also hold Shoot to charge up: slide your finger up for more force or down for less, and left or right to turn the arrow, then release to fire the selected blob. Slide down to 0% and release to cancel. Shoot stays ready while other blobs move or refill; you can also grab another ready blob before its previous movement finishes. A quick press is gentle; a longer hold is stronger. You can also drag inside the glass to aim: drag farther for more force and release to shoot. Dragging a ready blob cannot place it inside the bottle. Keyboard: left/right aim, up/down choose force, Space shoots.

03

More little friends

New blobs shoot in from the left or right with values 2, 4, 8, 16, or 32. They bump, push, and squash against the other ready blobs. Matching neighbors merge on contact. Your stiffness and viscosity settings also affect the preparation row. Refill continues until three are ready. Merges in the pile earn points.

04

Mind the dotted line

A partially spilled blob stays in play while any part is inside. The round ends only once the whole blob slides out; you can watch it fall before the result appears. The dotted line is a capacity guide. Lifting and rearranging never shoot. Downward pulls launch only on release.

Your game saves in this browser. On iPhone, use Safari’s Share menu → Add to Home Screen for an app-like view.
